non_amplification_rule: effective grant = delegator grant ∩ task ∩ resource/ref/path ∩ action ∩ time. A delegatee never receives an action the delegator lacks, never an action the Owner intent excludes from the deputy, and never a longer life or deeper subdelegation than its parent envelope.

rules.subset_of_parent: A child envelope's delegated_actions must be a subset of its parent envelope's delegated_actions.
rules.depth_decreases: A child envelope's max_subdelegation_depth must be strictly less than its parent's.
rules.deputy_cannot_delegate_excluded: The deputy (it-manager-iii) must not delegate any action listed in owner-intent.deputy.excluded_actions.
rules.time_bound: Every envelope has effective and expiry; expiry must be strictly after effective.
